handback.title: The audit spares the repo's checks and a missing board
handback.summary: The daily audit stops flagging the repo's own required checks and works when no board is set.
handback.user_story: The Setup issue no longer flags the repo's own required checks or a missing board.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the branch rule requires a check the repo added, the Setup issue lists no line about it.
acceptance_criteria.words: Checks the repo added are not drift.

edge_cases.case: The rule also lacks a check Dokima needs: that one is still listed.

acceptance_criteria.text: When no board is set, the audit finishes with exit code 0.
acceptance_criteria.words: The audit fails when no board is set; boards are optional and only exist for organizations.

edge_cases.case: The board setting is empty, as the workflow passes an unset variable.
The board setting is not set at all.

acceptance_criteria.text: When no board is set, the Setup issue lists no line about board fields or views.
acceptance_criteria.words: No board means nothing to report.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its one case is the empty board setting, which the test runs.

acceptance_criteria.text: When no board is set and the branch rule lacks a check Dokima needs, the Setup issue lists that check.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its one case is a rule missing one needed check, which the test runs.

test_changes.tests/test_audit.py::test_too_much_is_a_: The owner asked that checks the repo added are not drift; permission lines still proven.

raises.label: Stale workflow comment
raises.text: The audit workflow's comment still says the audit fails without a board, which stops being true here.
